source_type: Official Ministry of Foreign Affairs Brunei Darussalam 2026/2027 scholarship page
funding_classification_basis: The official 2026/2027 BDGS page provides full tuition-fee exemption, economy-class incoming and return airfare, BND 500 monthly personal allowance, BND 150 monthly meal allowance, BND 600 annual book allowance, residential-college accommodation, baggage support and comprehensive insurance.
unresolved_fields: single age_limit because undergraduate/diploma and Master's limits differ
single mandatory IELTS or TOEFL hard-filter value because multiple English-proficiency alternatives are accepted
complete machine-readable nationality list because eligibility is expressed through foreign-student inclusion and exclusion rules
notes: Applications opened 15 December 2025 and closed 15 February 2026. The scholarship is available for Diploma, Undergraduate and Postgraduate Master's study at multiple Brunei institutions, so host_university_id is intentionally None.

source_type: Official Universiti Brunei Darussalam UGRS page and official UGRS terms and conditions
funding_classification_basis: Official UBD UGRS information provides tuition and registration/acceptance fee waiver, BND 2,200 monthly subsistence allowance for 36 months, free on-campus accommodation, incoming and outgoing economy-class airfare for candidates not residing in Brunei, overseas research or conference funding up to BND 3,000 and visa-fee support.
unresolved_fields: exact current scholarship application opening date
one strict age_limit because the official scholarship permits possible case-by-case exceptions
one mandatory English scalar because UBD accepts multiple proficiency routes and some programmes impose higher requirements
notes: UGRS is a PhD scholarship. The current UGRS page verifies the scheme and benefits but its application-period section still lists older intake cycles, so scholarship_status remains unknown instead of being guessed as open or closed.
